items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of beach-fire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by simple post (einfacher Brief). Per the letter's cited rule (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG SH), a letter sent by simple post is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting; posting is presumed on the document date 18.11.2026, so the 4th day is 22.11.2026 (Sunday). Since this falls on a Sunday, the deemed-delivery fiction shifts to the next working day, Monday 23.11.2026, which is the Bekanntgabe date. The Widerspruchsfrist is one month 'nach Bekanntgabe'. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (23.11.2026) is not counted, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB applies. Final deadline for the Widerspruch to reach the authority: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter cites a 4-day (not the more common 3-day) deemed-delivery rule for simple post under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG; the exact wording of that provision was not independently verified, and the computed deadline (23.12.2026) assumes the stated 4-day rule and the usual weekend/holiday extension for the deemed-delivery date are correctly applied — confirm the actual posting date if known, as it may differ from the document date.
